gotchas: PDP: press Enter on #form-action-addToCart did NOT add to bag; a real click after accepting OneTrust did.
PDP: .countPill--positive is hidden — prove the add with count(), not a visible wait.
Checkout: an existing-account email swaps in a password form; the guest path is still one click away ('continue as guest').
Payment: input[id*='credit'] matches #radio-paypalcommercecredit = PayPal PAY LATER, not the card method.
Payment: each Adyen frame holds decoy autocomplete inputs; a bare 'input' selector hits 4 elements — use input[data-fieldtype=...].
Payment: the #terms label intercepts clicks — press Space on the checkbox.
Outcome: a decline keeps the card form filled; do not refill, just re-click Place Order once if retrying.
Session: the bag lives in the proxied browser's cookies — a second open_page in the SAME session keeps it (3 navigations survived); a close_session + open_page starts empty.

Blind agents: never re-click Place Order after a 'Clicked' with no alert and no confirmation — poll outcome.declineAlert / outcome.orderConfirmation with count() first; a double click risks a double charge.
notes: Page-by-page walk, driven live 2026-08-27 with agent-pay (blind, no seeing browser), ~60 calls, no purchase (issuer declined the card at the last step). Cloudflare returns 403 to curl/fetch; the proxied browser passes. || PAGE 1 LISTING (not driven): products live at https://us.jellycat.com/<slug>/ (slug = lowercase name with hyphens, e.g. /peanut-penguin/, /smudge-rabbit/); category pages like /animals/arctic-antarctic; site search is BigCommerce default /search.php?search_query=<term>. A web search for 'jellycat.com <toy name>' returns the slug URL directly. || PAGE 2 PDP: size is a native <select> (overrides.pdp.sizeSelect); pick with kind:'select' and the size label (Small/Medium/Large...). Sold-out sizes are option[disabled] — count them first. Dismiss OneTrust (overrides.pdp.cookieAccept); the Attentive SMS popup (#attentive_overlay) also blocks on first visit. Then click overrides.pdp.addToCart. Proof: overrides.pdp.bagCountProof exists (hidden) with text '1'. || PAGE 3 BAG (optional): /cart.php; empty bag shows text 'bag is empty'. Skip it — go straight to /checkout. || PAGE 4 CHECKOUT · CUSTOMER: fill overrides.checkout.email, click #checkout-customer-continue. If the email has an account the form flips to a password login — click overrides.checkout.continueAsGuest to get the guest shipping form. || PAGE 5 CHECKOUT · SHIPPING: fill overrides.checkout.shipping* (country and state are <select>), click overrides.checkout.shippingContinue; shipping method auto-selects. || PAGE 6 CHECKOUT · PAYMENT: 5 radios (PayPal, PayPal Pay Later, Card=Adyen, Google Pay, Apple Pay). Select the card via overrides.payment.cardMethodRadio; Adyen mounts 3 iframes (number, expiry, CVC) plus a main-document holder-name input. Fill overrides.payment.* (expiry typed as MM/YY). Tick terms with press Space on overrides.payment.terms. || PAGE 7 PLACE ORDER: click overrides.payment.placeOrder. || PAGE 8 OUTCOME: success = overrides.outcome.orderConfirmation; decline = overrides.outcome.declineAlert, and the card form stays filled (.adyen-checkout__field--valid x4) so a retry is one more click. || COVERAGE — DRIVEN LIVE: PDP size select, add to bag, /checkout guest email, shipping form, Adyen card fill, terms, Place Order click, decline alert. ASSUMED (BigCommerce defaults, NOT observed here): listing/search URLs; quantity input on PDP (#qty[name="qty[]"], default 1); shipping-method radios when more than one option exists (only one appeared; it auto-selected); billing = shipping checkbox (left at default); .orderConfirmation success selector; 3-D Secure (none triggered). NOT DRIVEN: the signed-in path (password form after an account email); Apple/Google Pay; PayPal. SESSION RULE: the bag is a browser cookie — do PDP → checkout inside ONE agent-pay session; a close/open starts with an empty bag. FIELD ORDER: fill country before state (the state list depends on it). Idle > ~60s did not kill the session in this run; the whole walk is ~45 calls if you follow the overrides.

overrides.checkout.shippingMethodRadios: input[name="shippingOptionIds"]  (BigCommerce default; only one option appeared and auto-selected)
